title: Option 1: adopt a logit-adjusted (balanced-softmax) local loss? Development decision rule
motivation: Clean FedAvg labels 64-83% of MQTT and 69-79% of Spoofing as Benign; training share MQTT 1.0%, Spoofing 3.0%, Benign 36%.
change: train_defended.py --loss-adjustment logit: local loss CE(logits + tau*log(prior), y) with the pooled training class prior; inference unchanged; train_client itself untouched.
added_assumption: The global training class prior (pooled label counts) is known to all clients, like the pooled preprocessing already declared.
comparison: Clean FedAvg, seeds 47 and 48 (development seeds), --loss-adjustment logit --logit-tau 1.0 versus the existing matched runs logs/fedavg_seed47 and logs/fedavg_seed48 (loss none). Final-round validation metrics.
single_fallback: If tau 1.0 fails ONLY on IDS_FPR, Benign recall or accuracy, run tau 0.5 once under the same rule. Otherwise stop and report; no further tuning.
validation_use: Validation labels inform this development choice; the official test split remains unused. Seeds 47-48 are development seeds; Phase 2b uses fresh seeds.
not_decided_here: Backdoor learnability and detector behaviour under the new loss (checked by recalibration, the pre-live gate and Phase 2b).
